basis: FERPA binds an educational agency or institution to which funds have been made available under a Department of Education program (34 CFR 99.1(a)). The business does not participate in Title IV and is not a financial institution: it extends no credit and offers no financing; parents pay per session or prepay packages (author's analysis of 16 CFR 314.1 and 314.2)

The business is an operator of a website or online service directed to children (16 CFR 312.2): the members-only portal is built for students in grades 2 to 7 and collects first and last names, user names, photos of work, reading-aloud audio and messages from its student members (34 current); 36 of the 55 active students are under 13. Online session recordings add children's images and voices. No small-business exemption; 312.8(b) scales the program to size. The 2025 amendments had a compliance date of 2026-04-22
Applies only to E-Rate recipients. The business is not a school or library and receives no E-Rate discounts
Not a health care provider or covered entity (45 CFR 160.103). Evaluations in student folders are shared by parents; they are protected under Fla. Stat. 501.171 instead
